parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
A solid cylinder of weight 24 N is made of material of density 850 kg m^{-3}. The cylinder has a
length of 0.18 m, as shown in Fig. 1.1.
Show that the cross-sectional area A of the cylinder is 0.016 m^{2}.

A solid cylinder of weight 24 N is made of material of density 850 kg $m^{-3}$. The cylinder has a
length of 0.18 m, as shown in Fig. 1.1.
Show that the cross-sectional area A of the cylinder is 0.016 $m^{2}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The cylinder in (a) is attached by a spring to the bottom of a rigid container of liquid, as shown
in Fig. 1.2.
The cylinder is in equilibrium with its bottom face at a depth of 0.17 m below the surface of the
liquid. The tension in the spring is 8.0 N.
